item.title: Staff Post - Wikiwalk Proposal
item.content:encoded:
Timer Expired. Edits made as discussed below. Author may revert at any time.

The WikiWalk team is proposing edits to this page. All proposed edits will be in a collapsible below this post, and after 7 days if there are no serious objections to the edits, the feedback received will be taken into account as the edits are made. If you have questions not directly related to the article about this project, please pm a member of the WikiWalk Team

+ Show Block
- Hide Block

Got two simple ones for all to consider. First off, the containment procedures can be slightly altered from "standard secure vehicle garage" to "Anomalous Vehicle Containment Bay" as the latter gives a more formal approach to the containment unit and allow for a link to Reach's Blueprints. Additionally, there is an excellent poem written about this article titled I Talked With 516 One Day, which can easily in-line linked within the article. As such, I am recommending the following edits:

Changing this:

SCP-516 may be kept in a standard secure vehicle garage. Routine vehicle maintenance should be carried out on a bi-weekly basis. SCP-516 is not to be provided with fuel or ammunition except under controlled testing circumstances. Following Incident 516-1A, no personnel with a history of military service should be assigned to SCP-516.

To this:

SCP-516 may be kept in an Anomalous Vehicle Containment Bay. Routine vehicle maintenance should be carried out on a bi-weekly basis. SCP-516 is not to be provided with fuel or ammunition except under controlled testing circumstances. Following Incident 516-1A, no personnel with a history of military service should be assigned to SCP-516.

Changing this:

SCP-516-1 may be operated manually, but is selective about its targets. In general, it will only 'permit' its operator to fire on nonliving targets, nonsapient biological targets or armed humans. Under these circumstances it will fire as a normal armament piece. If a target does not satisfy these conditions (essentially, being an unarmed, sapient being) SCP-516-1 will jam. Attempts to prevent jamming through maintenance or parts replacement have failed.

To this:

SCP-516-1 may be operated manually, but is selective about its targets. In general, it will only 'permit' its operator to fire on nonliving targets, nonsapient biological targets or armed humans. Under these circumstances it will fire as a normal armament piece. If a target does not satisfy these conditions (essentially, being an unarmed, sapient being) SCP-516-1 will jam. Attempts to prevent jamming through maintenance or parts replacement have failed.

If anyone has other/better examples that could be used here please leave a comment saying so!

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: The only think I don't like is the "jamming" that happens when it doesn't want to fire. A tank from this time would have an electric transmitter and receiver that causes the firing mechanism to trigger. It would be more believable if it didn't respond to the transmitter than something within the firing system to "jam". This also allows the receiver to be bypassed and have the firing system activated directly which would be like physically forcing someone to shoot another person. This could lead to the tank harboring ill feelings toward the foundation and looking for a chance to fight back.
